description: Search the catalog by title or author across all languages, returning matching book records (title, author, lang, slug, chapter_count, word_count and URLs). When to use: you have a title or author and need the lang+slug that every other tool requires; also the right first step when you do not know which language a work belongs to. Do not use: to find words inside the text of books - that is cyberlibrary_fulltext_search. Returns: {query, lang, searched_languages, matches_returned, books[]}.

lang.description: Optional language code to restrict the search.

query.description: Substring matched against title and author (case-insensitive).

name: cyberlibrary_search_books
